name: Paskahousu
description: Paskahousu (Finnish for 'shit pants') is a Finnish shedding game related to Shithead. Play cards equal or higher than the pile; 2s, 10s, and Aces have special effects. Last player with cards loses.

overview.description: Paskahousu (Finnish for 'shit pants') is a Finnish shedding game related to Shithead. Play cards equal or higher than the pile; 2s, 10s, and Aces have special effects. Last player with cards loses.

history.origins: Finnish game; name means a coward. Related to Shithead, which spread via backpackers. Face-up version; face-down version is Valepaska.
timeline: Present: Popular in Finland; variants include Pöytäpaska (table), Ruotsalainen (Swedish).
history.cultural: Crude name reflects casual, youth-oriented play.
history.evolution: Valepaska (face-down cards) split to separate page. Pöytäpaska adds table cards like Shithead.

setup.deck: Standard 52 cards. Rank: 2 (high), A, K, Q, J, 10...3 (low). 2s, 10s, Aces are special.
setup.dealing: Deal 2+2+1 = 5 cards each. Remainder stacked face down = stock.

rules.objective: Get rid of all your cards. Last player holding cards is paskahousu (loser).
rules.gameplay: 1. **Start**: Player with most 3s leads (or 4s, 5s...). 2. **Play**: Play 1+ cards of same rank ≥ pile top. Restrictions: pictures only on >6; Aces only on pictures or Aces; 2s on anything except Ace/10; 10s and Aces clear. 3. **Pick up**: Cannot play → take whole pile. 4. **Draw**: If stock not empty, may draw and try to play; if illegal, take drawn card + pile. 5. **Replenish**: After playing, draw to 5 until stock empty. 6. **Clear**: 10 on lower, Ace on picture, or four-of-a-kind on top clears pile; same player plays again.
keyRules: 2: Play on any except Ace/10; nothing plays on 2 except 2.
10: On lower card clears pile; on empty table stays (only 10s on 10).
Ace: On picture clears pile; on empty stays (only Aces on Ace).
Four of a kind on top clears pile.
Pictures only if top >6; Aces only on picture or Ace.

strategy.basic: Save 2s for blocking. Draw from stock when stuck to try a playable card.
strategy.intermediate: Pick up voluntarily when pile has strong cards. Clear pile to deny opponents.
strategy.advanced: Hold at least as many 2s as the player before you. Time clears for maximum impact.
tips: Build a strong hand before stock runs out.
Drawing and trying can save you from pickup.
Clearing with 10 or Ace gives you another turn.

variations.name: Pöytäpaska
variations.description: Table shit: 4 face-down + 4 face-up per player. Play hand first, then face-up, then blind face-down. Like Shithead.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Variant uses different deal and table layout; engine overrides can be added when implementing this variant.

variations.name: Ruotsalainen
variations.description: Swedish: all cards dealt; no stock.
variations.emptyOverridesReason: No-stock variant; overrides for deal and draw rules can be added when needed.

variations.name: Two Decks
variations.description: With 6+ players, use two decks. Four-of-a-kind may not clear (house rule).
variations.emptyOverridesReason: Two-deck and optional clear rule; overrides for deckCount and burnRules when implemented.

scoring.winCondition: Avoid being the last player with cards.

synthesis.shortDescription: Finnish Shithead variant. 2/10/Ace special. Play or pick up. Last with cards loses.
